summary: John's 3rd great-aunt; first of Henry's siblings born in America.
bio:
Her Pennsylvania birth about Sept 1869 bounds the family's emigration to before then.

'Clarissa' (an infant born in Pennsylvania in September, 1870 census) and 'Fressa' (11, 1880 census) are almost certainly Theresa Meier (I282608085064). Theresa's own 1896 marriage docket gives her birth as 10 September 1868 at Hazleton ([R4-S1]). Henry's household had no other daughter of that age. The 1880 'Fressa' is a phonetic spelling of 'Theresa' (German 'Resa'/'Tresa'), and the 1870 'Clarissa' is an enumerator's guess. FamilySearch carries the same duplicate, as 'Frassa Myer' (GK2H-S7D), separate from Theresa (G7GQ-D75). This record should be merged into I282608085064.
sources: [R4-S1] Luzerne County Orphans' Court Marriage License Docket No. 21146: Thomas A. Boyle × Theresa Meier, 1896 (FamilySearch index 1:1:VF9K-ZC5) (primary) https://ancestors.familysearch.org/service/tree/tree-data/published/sources/G7GQ-D75/images/i/1/image.jpg
